description: S2. Derevi, Empyrial Tactician, Emiel the Blessed and Gaea's Cradle on derevi's turn (pod 2iA_Jt0d6sM), five creatures in play so Cradle taps for 5, and Walking Ballista as the outlet. The loop: tap Cradle, pay 3 to blink Derevi with Emiel, Derevi's enter trigger untaps Cradle; net mana grows each pass and goes into Ballista counters and pings. Tests the trigger target (in games Derevi untapped Cradle after an Emiel blink 0 of 216 times). Success: derevi wins on the scenario turn.
notes: Deviation: Walking Ballista is not in derevi's list. The plan names it as the outlet, so the harness places it (the writer warns); the plan arm's plan data does not know the card.
Gaea's Cradle's mana ability never reaches the stack, so the report counts Emiel activations and Derevi triggers, not Cradle taps.
Opponents hold no instant-speed interaction; every seat at 40 life.
